title: Periyar 2018 flood: open-data D-Flow FM model, sensitivity and uncertainty workflow (research code and results)
description: Research code, per-run results and manuscript sources for the article "How far can one gauge mark and one radar image narrow parameter uncertainty in an open-data flood model? Sensitivity analysis of the 2018 Periyar flood". The study code is in research/periyar and research/gsa; it builds on the HYDROLIB-core library by Deltares (MIT licence), which this fork contains unchanged. See research/periyar/REPRODUCE.md for installation, reproduction and reuse.
